description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation -The charges applicable for the usage of all aerodromes in Sri Lanka Except Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA) and Ratmalana Airport and that shall come into effect on 01st July
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It establishes new charges for aerodrome usage and amends previous regulations. The content focuses entirely on legal/regulatory matters - creating new statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for aviation services - without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or detailed ministerial portfolio descriptions.
